Files without ballotVersion preserve the prior composition.
The prior ballotVersion is still accepted and solved with its original composition. The v2 adds the announced Recortes Cero pact in Aragón.

v4 removes independent Podemos and CUP ballots in Catalunya. Fixed editorial transfers apply only to pending source pools; absorbed polling regimes constrain calibration geography without additional transfers. v1-v3 keep their original semantics.
